interfaces.name: Zoom Workplace client (web, desktop, mobile)
interfaces.technology: Browser web client and native desktop/mobile GUI apps
interfaces.classification_rationale: Actions are expressed by manipulating presented affordances of a persistent, navigable representation of the user's Zoom state; the three surfaces share this primitive and control structure, so they form one logical Interactive interface.

provenance.evidence: Official download center distributes the first-party Zoom Workplace app for web, desktop, and mobile.
Support documentation on downloading the Zoom Workplace desktop and mobile app.

interfaces.name: REST API v2
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined operations through structured HTTP requests; one base and auth cover many resource groups, so it is one interface.

provenance.evidence: Requests go to https://api.zoom.us/v2/ with an access token using standard HTTP methods against documented endpoints.

interfaces.name: SCIM2 provisioning API
interfaces.technology: HTTPS, base https://api.zoom.us, paths under /scim2/, application/scim+json, OAuth (scim2 scope)
interfaces.classification_rationale: Operation invocation over HTTP, but a distinct base path and standardized SCIM contract and content type separate it from REST v2, so it is counted separately.

provenance.evidence: Zoom SCIM2 API provides user and group provisioning via User and Group resources using REST-compatible HTTP methods, application/scim+json, and OAuth with the scim2 scope against server https://api.zoom.us.

interfaces.name: Zoom Rooms Control System API (ZR-CSAPI)
interfaces.technology: SSH terminal on port 2244, plain-text CLI commands
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer invokes provider-defined operations through structured CLI commands over SSH; command-line editing is input handling, not a navigable state representation, so it is Programmatic and not Interactive.

provenance.evidence: ZR-CSAPI exposes an SSH interface on port 2244 that accepts CLI terminal commands and translates them to a proprietary Zoom Room API.

interfaces.name: Webhooks
interfaces.technology: Provider-initiated HTTPS POST to a consumer-hosted endpoint
interfaces.classification_rationale: The service initiates the interaction when subscribed events occur and delivers JSON payloads to a consumer-controlled HTTPS receiver.

provenance.evidence: Real-time notifications are sent to a consumer-specified HTTPS endpoint that accepts POST requests when subscribed events occur.

interfaces.name: WebSockets
interfaces.technology: Persistent socket held by the consumer to receive pushed events
interfaces.classification_rationale: Same event-notification primitive as webhooks but a different delivery contract (consumer-held connection rather than consumer-hosted receiver), so it is a separate Event interface. Public beta.

provenance.evidence: Zoom offers WebSockets as an alternative method for real-time event notifications, currently in public beta.

interfaces.name: MCP Server
interfaces.technology: Remote MCP over streamable HTTP, gateway https://mcp.zoom.us/ and regional URLs
interfaces.classification_rationale: Capability discovery, authentication, and dynamic tool use are part of the interaction contract, which places it in Agentic rather than Programmatic.

provenance.evidence: Zoom's MCP servers follow the Model Context Protocol and let AI agents discover, authenticate, and use tools dynamically without custom integration per system; regional gateway URLs under mcp.zoom.us are listed.

interfaces.name: AI Companion assistant (ZoomMate)
interfaces.technology: Natural-language assistant panel across Workplace and a web surface
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer expresses actions through natural-language messages interpreted by the service, and tool orchestration is internal to the product, which fixes it as Conversational rather than Agentic.

provenance.evidence: Zoom's online AI chat, powered by AI Companion, is a conversational interface where the user asks questions in natural language and receives context-aware answers.
ZoomMate, the AI Companion assistant, answers natural-language questions and can execute tasks and workflows described in plain language across Zoom Workplace.

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: No navigable TUI dashboard exists; the only terminal-accessible official interface is ZR-CSAPI (Programmatic).

access_mechanism_ledger.mechanism: Zoom Rooms Control System API (SSH CLI)

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Retired per the developer API index; the live assistant is captured as the Conversational interface.
Build platform for developers to create bots, not a provider interface to Zoom's own service.

access_mechanism_ledger.mechanism: Video SDK, Meeting SDK, Cobrowse SDK, Zoom Apps SDK
access_mechanism_ledger.detail: SDKs and client libraries, which implement or embed interfaces without being one.
A collection of prepared REST requests, not a distinct interface.

access_mechanism_ledger.mechanism: Community / third-party CLIs and MCP servers

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Announced as a prototyping tool with no confirmed current status as an official general access interface.
